title: Grateful Dead Live at Fillmore East on 1970-02-13
lineage: Dat (Sony R500) -> Sound Devices 744T -> Samplitude Professional v10.2 -> FLAC
source: SBD -> Master Reel (7 inch 1/2 Track at 15ips) -> Dat (48k)

ai_review.summary: An excellent soundboard transfer of the legendary Feb 13 1970 show, famed for a soaring Dark Star, monster The Other One and smoking Lovelight.
ai_review.review: The Miller‑fixed SBD capture is praised as crystal‑clear and “brilliant” by virtually every reviewer. Musically the concert is heralded as one of ’70’s all‑time greats – the electric second set bursts with Dark Star, The Other One and Lovelight, while the acoustic first set supplies classic Good Lovin’, China Cat Sunflower and a rare Pigpen‑led Katie May. Overall sentiment is overwhelmingly positive, with only one neutral/questioning review.

ai_rating.rationale: 21 reviews (18 five‑star) uniformly praise both performance and audio; the weighting heavily favors the show quality, which is described as legendary, while the recording is called “excellent” and “strong”.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Miller’s fix transfer is repeatedly described as crisp, strong and most excellent; reviewers note the matrix version as an even better source but overall the SBD is clean with no reported drop‑outs or distortion.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Two‑set structure (acoustic first set, electric second set) is lauded for its seamless flow; the electric set is described as a “monster” jam marathon that rides a groove‑heavy vibe from start to finish.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Garcia’s tone and improvisational flights on Dark Star, The Other One and Lovelight receive repeated praise.
